**Sikhae (Seaweed Soup) – A Quick & Easy Recipe** *This simple, comforting soup is perfect for a quick lunch or dinner. It’s usually served with rice and a side of kimchi.* --- ### Ingredients | Item | Amount | |------|--------| | **Kelp (seaweed)** | 1 sheet (about 5 cm × 15 cm) | | **Water** | 2 cups (480 ml) | | **Soy sauce** | 1 tablespoon | | **Sesame oil** | 1 teaspoon | | **Garlic** | 1 clove, minced | | **Green onion** | 1 stalk, sliced thinly | | **Optional add‑ins** | • ½ cup diced tofu
• ½ cup sliced mushrooms
• ½ cup spinach or bok choy | --- ### Equipment - Small saucepan or pot - Knife & cutting board - Measuring spoons --- ### Instructions 1. **Prep the Kelp** - Rinse the kelp under cold water to remove any grit. - Cut into bite‑sized strips (≈ 1–2 cm wide). 2. **Boil the Water** - In a small pot, bring 2 cups of water to a gentle boil. 3. **Add the Kelp** - Add the cut kelp to the boiling water. - Let it simmer for about 3 minutes until the kelp softens slightly. 4. **Season** - Stir in 1 Tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp sesame oil. - Add the minced garlic; let it cook for another minute so the aroma releases. 5. **Optional Extras** - If you’re adding tofu, mushrooms, or greens, toss them in now. - Simmer for an additional 2–3 minutes until everything is heated through. 6. **Finish** - Sprinkle sliced green onions over the top just before serving. 7. **Serve** - Ladle the hot soup into bowls. - Pair with steamed rice and a side of kimchi for a complete meal. --- ### Tips & Variations - **Flavor Boost:** Add a splash of fish sauce or a pinch of sugar if you prefer a sweeter, umami‑rich broth. - **Texture Play:** For crunch, stir in some julienned carrots or bell pepper at the end. - **Protein Upgrade:** Replace tofu with diced chicken breast or shrimp for a heartier dish. - **Make Ahead:** Store leftover broth in the fridge; reheat and add fresh kelp when ready to serve. Enjoy your homemade sikhae!
